name: Einkehr Guntschau
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Einkehr Guntschau in Tirol**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. At **Einkehr Guntschau**, we invite you to savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all made with local ingredients.

Our rustic **Einkehr** (country inn) offers a cozy retreat after a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh berries or enjoy a warm bowl of **Käsespätzle**—a true Tyrolean comfort food.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Guntschau** is the perfect spot to unwind and experience the warmth of Tyrolean culture. Whether you're here for the food, the scenery, or the friendly atmosphere, **Einkehr Guntschau** promises an unforgettable stay in the mountains.
